content: Implement the M0110 W0112 local character-device transport slice over the generated Linux UAPI: negotiate a generation-bound queue, map the shared ring, encode CPU Add/Copy-compatible copy descriptors, and provide a leased worker that consumes and completes the ring without changing the inherited M0100 descriptor.

Content revision c53b5b6 adds the C17 cdev client, C++20 worker, paired submission/completion ring mapping, generated-header kernel portability, and metaflux_core.ko source/Kbuild. Transport schema validation, component graph validation, and focused CTest passed 5/5; the default GCC Kbuild produced metaflux_core.ko against Linux 6.18.42.

The current CachyOS 6.18 Kbuild flags reject LLVM=1 before compiling this module; the GCC path is the valid evidence for this target. Eventfd attachment, memory registration/pinning, daemon-controlled replacement generations, and end-to-end payload/backend wiring remain open W0112/W0114 work.

Content revision 7ba52c5 implements the W0112 payload/event notification stage: MF_UAPI_IOCTL_MEMORY_ALLOC provisions one generation-bound driver arena mapped through MF_UAPI_MMAP_PAYLOAD_V0 with VMA tombstone reaping; queue and worker lease accept one complete eventfd pair with retained eventfd_ctx references and owner exclusivity. The C17 client exposes eventfd-aware open and payload allocation/close helpers. Full development CTest passed 75/75, cdev focused tests passed 2/2, transport schema passed 5 definitions/15 records, and Linux 6.18.42 GCC Kbuild built metaflux_core.ko with modpost success. Agent Harness (codex) is both commit author and committer.

MEMORY_REGISTER remains explicitly unsupported pending FOLL_PIN/SG accounting and compat shims. Queue kref/tombstone ownership, daemon-controlled generation replacement, mf_backend_api_v1 wiring, end-to-end mapped Add/Copy, and KUnit/KASAN/KCSAN/lockdep/kmemleak qualification remain open; LLVM=1 remains unqualified on this target.

Content revision 4465732 implements one generation-bound caller-owned MEMORY_REGISTER range up to 64 MiB: FOLL_LONGTERM pinning with optional FOLL_WRITE, normal memlock accounting, SG-table construction, partial-pin unwind, dirty-unpin on teardown, explicit unregister, and owner-close revocation. The C17 client exposes registration and generation-aware close; the UAPI manifest and lifecycle-extension import hash are synchronized. Focused cdev/lifecycle tests passed 4/4, full development CTest passed 79/79, and Linux 6.18.42 GCC Kbuild built metaflux_core.ko with modpost success. Agent Harness (codex) is both commit author and committer.

The registered-memory fixture deliberately owns one global range and publishes no backend dma_map_sg or in-flight device reference. Queue kref/tombstone ownership, daemon-controlled generation replacement, backend payload wiring, and KUnit/KASAN/KCSAN/lockdep/kmemleak plus owner-death qualification remain open; LLVM=1 remains unqualified on this target.

Content revision 9dc324d wires the cdev worker to an explicit CdevBackendBinding seam: sized-table and MF_BACKEND_CAP_COPY validation, nonzero handle checks, checked base-relative mf_backend_copy_v1 translation, shared-status mapping, and no silent fallback for malformed bindings. The fake backend regression covers success, timeout, and unsupported capability. Full development CTest passed 79/79; component graph and transport schema passed; Agent Harness (codex) is both commit author and committer.

The backend binding is deliberately synchronous and only covers one payload memory handle. Production CPU memory import, Add/Copy execution, backend DMA mapping, in-flight reference draining, queue krefs, daemon replacement, and lifecycle/fault qualification remain open; an unbound worker retains the local fixture memmove path.

Content revision cc24af0 exposes the CPU backend transport-facing COPY subset: one enumerated device, instance/context/queue handles, caller-owned host-memory import, and synchronous overlap-safe COPY with strict handle, size, range, and completion-event validation. The cdev worker integration binds the real API to mapped payload; Agent Harness (codex) is both commit author and committer.

Focused CTest passed 2/2 for metaflux.transport.cdev-worker and metaflux.abi.backend-cpu; full development CTest passed 79/79; component graph passed 19 components and 23 dependency edges; clang-format and git diff checks passed.

The CPU backend increment is limited to synchronous COPY. Launch/Add, asynchronous events, generation-bound registered-memory import, backend dma_map_sg and in-flight references, queue krefs, daemon replacement, and KUnit/KASAN/KCSAN/lockdep/kmemleak qualification remain open W0112 work.

Content revision 70f332c fixes the cdev queue VMA tombstone backing lifetime: an offline queue mapping is retained while VMAs remain and reclaimed under the cdev lock from the final VMA close; kernel documentation records the invariant. Agent Harness (codex) is both commit author and committer.
Linux 6.18.42 GCC Kbuild built metaflux_core.ko with modpost success; full development CTest passed 79/79 through the Nix development shell; git diff --check passed.

Queue VMA backing reaping is complete, but the static queue tombstone still has no kref graph, backend reference drain, daemon-controlled generation replacement, owner-death qualification, or KUnit/KASAN/KCSAN/lockdep/kmemleak evidence.
